description: REEF3D::SEASTATE reflecting coasts (A 723 0.5 4: Kr 0.5, diffuse cos^4; Phase 6b): swell at 30 deg (JONSWAP gamma 10, cos^50, Tp 8 s) on a coast at 120 deg (bathymetry raster, staircase of 30 m cells), the coastline normal from the land cells within 2 cells (A 724 2), and a reflecting line obstacle with diffuse reflection (A 722, A 726); spectral sparsity A 795 (whole quadrant in the reflecting cells). 50 x 50 cells of 30 m, depth 20 m. Validation in Dropbox SEASTATE/validation/36_coasts (SWAN OBSTACLE REFL along the coast).
covers: seastate_obstacle coast faces and the coast normal
seastate_implicit diffuse reflection, sparsity windows of reflecting cells
